scope.next_implementation_stage: P7; this package contains design verification, not implemented experiment algorithms

allocation.ranking: SHA256(UTF8(seed|P6|task|stratum|namespaced_subject)); lexicographic hex order; subject ID is a string
allocation.fold_ranking: SHA256(UTF8(seed|P6|fold|task|stratum|namespaced_subject)); rank modulo 3, within label strata where applicable
allocation.identity_limit: Cross-study non-overlap is a provenance assumption, not civil identity verification; left/right wrists, a/b segments, records, conditions and events are not additional participants.

eligibility.af_afl: Official AFIB/AFL versus N, not pure AF versus healthy. Perioperative finger PPG and paired ECG; no wrist external-validation claim.
eligibility.hr_reliability: Use P4 qualified reference windows without outcome-based exclusion; PPG-Sport two wrists stay paired within person/time. Galaxy reference is Polar chest-device HR, not new raw ECG reannotation.
eligibility.stress: Stress-Predict author binary task-state labels unchanged. WESAD 2=>1; 1/3/4=>0; 0/5/6/7, mixed and boundary-crossing windows excluded. Source protocol differences are reported, not hidden.

preprocessing.intervals: half-open [start,end), incomplete tail excluded; source clocks and P2-P5 boundary/guard rules remain fixed
preprocessing.resampling: polyphase anti-aliasing with rational ratio from declared native fs; only the completed window, no neighboring or future samples; native SHDB 200 Hz to 125 Hz = 5/8

filter.implementation: Butterworth SOS forward-backward within the completed window only

preprocessing.invalid_signal: Reject/mark technical unavailability before processing nonfinite, declared missing or constant PPG/ECG. Constant ACC is permitted; constant EDA is a zero-quality secondary tool, not a new cohort exclusion. Never median-impute missing values. Preserve qualification windows, unavailable decisions, stream blocks and exclusion reasons; do not remove people because models fail.
preprocessing.ECG_peaks: wfdb.processing.xqrs_detect on the fixed filtered ECG lead and declared analysis sampling rate, learn=True, verbose=False; no reference-label-driven polarity or lead selection. Fixed WFDB version saved before P7; RR failure recorded, not healed using rhythm truth.
preprocessing.causality: Decision time is window end plus compute latency. Within-window zero-phase filtering is not a zero-latency streaming filter. No timestamps are backdated.
preprocessing.ppg_ecg_cnn_scaling: per-window median/MAD with epsilon 1e-6; scalers/features fitted on training people only
preprocessing.acc_channel: norm of native 3 axes, median-centered and MAD-scaled per completed window, then interpolate to BVP 64 Hz; preserve declared units and do not invent g units
preprocessing.eda_cnn_scaling: training-person equal-weight global mean/std, epsilon 1e-6; retain tonic level, do not per-window center away all tonic information

classical.HR_failure_feature: Missing HR maps to 0 only in standardized feature-vector construction with an additional binary failure feature; never output 0 bpm as an estimate. Feature schema fixed and saved.

cnn.blocks: Conv1d+BatchNorm+ReLU; maxpool(2) in first two blocks; global mean pool
cnn.early_stop: grouped training-person CV validation cross-entropy; never random window validation; refit all training people for median best epoch of three folds (half-up integer rounding)

models.sampling: No evaluation subsampling. Base training window weight=1/(number of training people * that person's qualified window count); scaler uses this equal-person base. Logistic class balancing uses inverse of weighted label mass (not unweighted window frequency), followed by normalization to fixed total weight. CNN samples an available label uniformly, a contributing training person uniformly, then a qualified window of that label uniformly; save realized draws. One epoch uses the number of training windows. Policy/conformal people never enter optimizer/scaler. Missing a train class fails rather than silently fitting a one-class model.
models.monitor_models: Separate 10-second and 30-second ECG models, same training people; 30-second training windows are contiguous nonoverlapping triples with pure identical labels and valid ECG, no gap splicing. Do not squeeze 30 seconds into a 10-second tensor.
models.quick: Use deterministic leading-ranked training people (VitalDB 3 per class; other tasks 3), policy/conformal/evaluation 3 per role (VitalDB 3 per class). Monitor at most first 2 hours per chosen record, other tasks 60 windows/person. Smoke outputs clearly marked incomplete; full retrains from scratch on all locked people, epochs and qualified windows. No quick output is primary evidence.

hr_target.label: 1 if absolute PPG HR error >10 bpm OR PPG HR unavailable; else 0. Exactly 10 is reliable. Engineering target, not manually annotated signal quality.

ppg_estimator.estimate: 60/median(valid RR); failure=>null, not zero; negative polarity is not selected using reference HR

hr_target.dalia_reference: Existing author ECG-derived HR on 8-second segments, hop 2 seconds; segment k=[2k,2k+8), center=2k+4. Ten-second reference is median of finite author HR values with centers in [start,end). This is an aggregated ECG-derived reference, not an instantaneous clinician truth. P7 must verify label count against available signal duration and readme; any unexplained offset/count fails rather than searching for outcome-optimal lag.
hr_target.reference_sensitivity: DaLiA secondary analysis uses only 8-second source HR segments wholly inside the 10-second window. P4 source-specific reference definitions remain unchanged.
hr_target.reference_oracle: Reference correction and adaptive reference invocation are OFFLINE simulation only. Corrected HR equals the reference by construction; post-correction dangerous-acceptance error is recomputed and zero MAE is not a validated ECG prediction. No claim of wrist ECG acquisition or measured oracle acquisition latency.

quality.definitions: B=Welch power inside modality filter band / total Welch power; H=normalized entropy of nonnegative Welch bins; V_RR=RR intervals in [0.3,2.0] seconds / all detected RR intervals; no peaks=>0 RR stability and valid fraction. ECG uses fixed ECG peak detector, not PPG peaks.
quality.motion_penalty: Primary BVP+ACC proxy multiplied by 1/(1+J); J=std(diff(ACC_norm))/std(ACC_norm); if std=0 J=0; denominator uses epsilon=1e-6*max(abs(mean),std,1e-12). Unit-independent ratio, no reference HR or stress labels involved.
quality.eda_proxy: std(raw EDA)/(std(raw EDA)+0.01) in declared microSiemens; unknown units fail schema gate, no assumed conversion
quality.quantile_method: smallest observed q at which mean of within-person empirical CDFs >= requested fraction; separate modality/duration thresholds; no evaluation distribution fitting
quality.acceptance: Primary-only decision needs primary quality pass. Called-secondary fusion needs secondary quality pass; low primary quality reduces fusion weight and does not veto secondary rescue. Any called-secondary technical/quality failure yields abstention, not a post-hoc best-modality switch. Offline HR oracle requires valid independent reference only.

conformal.rank: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); order statistic, if rank>n use +infinity, never clip to max score
conformal.membership: 1-p_class <= quantile; equality included; retain empty, singleton and doubleton sets
conformal.primary_claim: Window-pooled conformal on repeated windows and across sources is empirical calibration only. Report observed set coverage and person-cluster uncertainty. No guaranteed conditional, selected, cross-domain, patient or clinical safety coverage.
conformal.acceptance: Classification: singleton plus applicable quality rule; HR: singleton {reliable=0} plus primary quality, unless valid offline reference correction is called. Non-singleton/empty/technical failure => abstain.
conformal.diagnostic: One hash-ranked qualified window per conformal person, standard finite-sample rank diagnostic reported separately. With 3 people and alpha=.10, rank=4>3 gives all-class sets. This is not silently substituted by window n to claim 90% patient coverage.

planner.bins: 4x4 equal-width bins on [0,1] quality and confidence; 1 included in last bin
planner.gain: person-macro primary 0/1 error minus fused 0/1 error; HR oracle benefit is person-macro primary dangerous-error indicator minus corrected indicator. Technical failures contribute loss=1 in fit. No evaluation reference/error enters call decisions.
planner.shrinkage: m/(m+5)*bin_gain + 5/(m+5)*global_gain where m is distinct policy people in bin; <3 people uses global gain; do not clip negative gains upward
planner.latency_ratio: (secondary-plus-fusion p95 latency)/(primary p95 latency), profiled only on policy people, positive finite denominator; estimates and machine recorded before conformal fit. Offline HR reference-oracle uses ratio=1 as a conceptual comparison, NOT a measured acquisition estimate; never profile already-read reference as free sensor acquisition.
planner.call_rule: gain > lambda*incremental_normalized_cost*latency_ratio AND remaining budget >= full incremental cost; equality does not call. No test secondary prediction, quality or label is read to decide call.
planner.cost_accounting: Integer hundredths for budget accounting (primary100,quality15,ECG300,EDA150,fusion5); exact equality allowed, no floating overspend tolerance
planner.under_primary_budget: If quality strategy cannot pay 1.15, abstain without violating budget. When it can pay primary+quality but not secondary, return primary decision subject to its set/quality.
planner.oracle_latency: NA for physical reference acquisition; normalized cost is conceptual, not measured sensor energy. Show proxy CPU timing separately if implemented, never a fabricated zero acquisition latency.

monitoring.native_source: SHDB-AF 1.0.1 released ECG1, 200 Hz, resampled to 125 Hz within completed windows
monitoring.light_tool: 10-second fixed ECG peaks -> HR, RR_CV, RMSSD, pNN50, valid_RR_fraction and peak_count plus HR_failure -> training-only StandardScaler and weighted-balanced logistic probability, fixed C=1; every technically valid 10-second block
monitoring.fixed: Collect 30 seconds then call 30-second heavy ECG model every 30 seconds on the last completed 30 seconds; light stream is computed for fair comparison but never changes fixed cadence.
monitoring.adaptive: Same 30-second stable cadence and startup. A change point after >=6 valid ticks switches to 10-second heavy model at that tick and for six ticks total including trigger. First subsequent stable call is after collecting a new 30-second stable span. No future samples, skipped-gap splicing or truth-driven resets. Six-tick burn-in prevents the inevitable short-run sum of 1 during the first <=3 samples being mistaken for detected physiological change.
monitoring.reset: Only record boundaries, missing/nonfinite/constant ECG block or declared acquisition gaps reset BOCPD, buffer and alarm active state. Unknown/mixed rhythm labels DO NOT reset online state or remove the signal; they affect scoring only. Censored alarms at technical gaps are marked, not evidence of disappearance.
monitoring.cost: light .15 per 10-second available block; heavy cost 3*context_seconds/10 per call (10s=3,30s=9); all calls and latency recorded; report both normalized cost/hour and heavy calls/hour, never assume shorter context is free
monitoring.alarm_threshold_candidates: 101 equally spaced policy probability quantiles pooled across fixed/adaptive and 10/30-second heavy calls, plus +infinity always-no-alarm threshold; one common threshold per model family
monitoring.alarm_threshold_fit: Policy people only, before conformal fitting. A decision is preliminarily positive when p>=theta and called duration quality passes. The 5% cap uses MAX of fixed/adaptive non-target positive-decision fractions; denominator includes every technically valid scheduled known-negative decision, including quality abstentions as zero positives. Evaluate 90% event detection on these preliminary alarms. Feasible candidates: minimize false alarms/hour, then miss-penalized latency, then prefer larger threshold. If target infeasible under cap: maximize detection, then minimize FAR/hour, then larger threshold; record infeasible, never force an unsafe floor. No conformal/test feedback.
monitoring.final_alarm: After frozen threshold, fit conformal on separate people for each strategy/duration. Final positive iff singleton {1}, applicable quality pass, and p>=theta. At each heavy decision abstention is inactive, not normal-rhythm certainty. Final gating cannot raise preliminary positive-decision fraction on the SAME denominator; it can change alarm episode count, so FAR is not guaranteed by the 5% cap.
monitoring.held_state: Zero-order hold the last heavy alarm state until next heavy decision; inactive at record start and on technical failure/gap. A false-to-true transition is an alarm onset at window-end plus measured per-call latency, not window-start. Events and exposure use seconds on the native source clock; final decisions outside recording/exposure are unavailable, not retrospective matches. Do not backdate to annotation onset.
monitoring.observable_events: Exactly P5 qualifying AF/AFL episodes: >=30 seconds known target, >=30 seconds directly preceding known negative and valid onset-relative ECG blocks. AFIB->AFL is one event; initial/unknown-to-positive starts are left-censored; right endpoints half-open.
monitoring.match: One-to-one chronological matching: new alarm onset a detects event [t,u) iff t<=a<u and a<=t+120; no earlier already-active alarm is a new detection; unmatched qualifying event is missed, even if its duration<120. Never match through reference-unknown intervals.
monitoring.miss_penalized_latency: Per event: matched alarm-onset minus event-onset, otherwise 120; average events within each person then average people. Detected-only latency is secondary and NA if none detected.
monitoring.far_denominator: Hours of reference-known non-target intersect technically valid 10-second signal blocks, regardless tool calls, quality rejection or conformal abstention; unknown and missing exposure excluded, never abstained time. New alarm onset in that known-negative exposure is false; target alarm persisting into negative time contributes alarm occupancy, not a new onset.

endpoints.decision_loss: wrong accepted=1, abstain/technical no report=.2, correct accepted=0; HR wrong accepted means post-final-tool error>10 or invalid reported HR. Reportable HR failures always abstain. Offline corrected error uses corrected value, not pre-correction error.
endpoints.aggregation: Person macro first. VitalDB 0.5*mean(non-target people)+0.5*mean(target people). PPG-Sport average the two wrists at each identical person-time then aggregate person, never 58 independent people. All monitoring records of one person form one cluster. Each HR source and backup stress protocol reported separately.
endpoints.undefined: Risk/retained MAE with no reports => null+reason+denominator zero; AUROC with one class => null; detected-only delay with no detections => null; no negative exposure=>FAR null. Never report 0 risk as success for all-abstain/no-alarm.
endpoints.guard_scope: Descriptive predeclared guard only, not clinical safety proof; low-report strategies retained and labeled failure/tradeoff, never dropped.
endpoints.af_AUROC: Patient-level mean probability (equal window weights within person) versus patient label as primary discrimination; window-pooled AUROC secondary. Stress/HR per-person AUROC only when both labels exist; report contributing n and pooled diagnostic separately.

statistics.bootstrap_unit: person with all windows, wrists, records and strategies; paired contrast uses identical draw indices; VitalDB resamples 30 people per class independently
statistics.CI: 95% percentile, quantiles .025/.975 using linear interpolation. Fixed trained pipeline uncertainty only, not retraining or causal clinical effect uncertainty.
statistics.undefined_replicates: Do not turn undefined metrics into zero. Report valid replicate count; if <95% of 10000 valid, CI null with explanation. Primary decision-loss and penalized-delay have full person support.
statistics.primary_inference: Effect estimate and CI; no preclaimed power or statistically significant advantage. Optional exploratory exact two-sided paired sign test on nonzero person differences tests probability of improvement=.5, not a mean-difference null. Five main classical comparisons form one Holm family; CNN and sensitivity results exploratory, not a second chance at significance.
statistics.ties: Count and omit exact zero person differences in sign test; all ties=>p=1; report effective n
statistics.zero_error: Degenerate bootstrap [0,0] is not zero-risk proof; additionally report independent-person at-least-one-error proportion with Wilson interval and exact binomial bounds where applicable. With 30 independent people and zero person events, one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound is 1-.05^(1/30), approximately 9.5%, not 5%.
statistics.precision: Report Wilson worst-case binomial half-width, exact zero-event bound and illustrative standardized paired-mean detectable effect for n=23,29,30,60. These are design illustrations, not clinical sample-size adequacy claims; no event/window count used as independent n.

sensitivity.fit_sources: Retrain HR reliability label-threshold variants on training people only; change quality thresholds on train, planner/alarms on policy, conformal on its own people. No evaluation feedback. Alternative event duration reports changed contributor counts, never asserts all 30 still contribute.

profiling.sample_selection: hash-ranked policy windows, at most 20 per person, repeat cyclically to 200 calls; save IDs/durations/timings
profiling.end_to_end: Include required preprocessing, feature/quality extraction, primary call, actually selected secondary call, fusion, sets and decision; no timing after precomputing required features. Signal collection delay and disk IO separately reported.

P7_tests_required: source schema and exact sample-rate/label time support
Dalia label-count and reference offset consistency
native ECG missing and no imputation
multi-channel CNN and grouped early stopping
policy-conformal split and no reference access at call
runtime reset independent of reference labels
half-open alarm endpoints and one-to-one matches
implementation_acceptance.new_version_only: P7 independent protocol_p6_v1 version; no old model load, no old results overwritten; full starts only after P8 quick gate; test outcomes never tune parameters
implementation_acceptance.amendments: Any scientific/technical incompatibility that changes this design requires a dated versioned amendment before inspecting affected performance, reason and impact; do not silently change labels, people, thresholds or claim no possible future amendments.

references.topic: Wilson and exact binomial confidence intervals
